coordinateSystem: Three.js metres: X right, Y up, Z plan depth. Image centre faces world -Z. Image u increases toward world +X. Image top is +Y.
notes: Approved concept plans; not measured apartments or real property photography.
Peanut tone vinyl is a visual approximation, not an exact manufacturer swatch.
No terrace portals were invented: the exported full-height facade openings are windows. Tour exit is a navigation action at the entrance door.
Web images preserve native 8192x4096 dimensions; smaller variants are explicitly downsampled. Gallery views are perspective projections from the same panorama, without invented detail.
